answer: A falcon watch guards the trust graph: an identity mints only when k established agents from k distant branches stake a velvet bond, no two vouchers within three hops, all k co-signing at one summit sitting in one epoch, else the claim lapses. The k-th identity of one operator needs k vouchers from k new branches, each $50 bond locked ten epochs, slashed if the identity proves fake, so no branch rents twice and a farmer's clustered puppets cannot vouch for each other. 1000 puppets need 500,500 bonds, $25,025,000 locked; an honest newcomer needs one voucher and one $50 bond, once.
